prose: Marc Mortiboys, better known as the Dental Shaman, joins InnerVerse to speak the truth about the tooth! What's so shamanic about dentistry and how did initiation elevate Marc above the dime-a-dozen dentists of the world? Tune in to find out, along with what teeth mean in the biofield, how pH comes into play, the vagus nerve & gut health effects on oral regulation, and strategies for keeping your smile strong, and turning teeth around before the point of no return.
ext: We talk about light and sound therapies, terrain theory concepts applied to the mouth, the link between gum disease and modern health issues, navigating the healing crisis of the mouth, the relationship between individual teeth and meridians, wisdom teeth wisdom, myofunctional therapies, and much more!
